number.why: The source reports 11 hyperglycemia events with methylprednisolone and 7 with placebo, with randomized arm sizes of 61 and 59, respectively. These support the served count-based reconstruction. The RR is reconstructed, not directly reported; the hyperglycemia analysis population, assessment window, and confidence interval are not specified.

quotes.span: Hyperglycemia occurred in 11 patients (18%) in the methylprednisolone group and in 7 patients (12%) in the placebo group (P = .34).
Patients were randomized to receive either an intravenous bolus of 0.5 mg/kg per 12 hours of methylprednisolone (n = 61) or placebo (n = 59) for 5 days started within 36 hours of hospital admission.

entry.why: Hospitalized adults with severe community-acquired pneumonia and high inflammation form a restricted subset of the question's population. Adult eligibility and the systemic corticosteroid versus placebo comparison are established.

quotes.span: Effect of corticosteroids on treatment failure among hospitalized patients with severe community-acquired pneumonia and high inflammatory response: a randomized clinical trial.

Multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial conducted in 3 Spanish teaching hospitals involving patients with both severe community-acquired pneumonia and a high inflammatory response, which was defined as a level of C-reactive protein greater than 150 mg/L at admission.
ELIGIBILITY AGE/SEX: minimum age 18 Years | maximum age None | sex ALL
Patients were randomized to receive either an intravenous bolus of 0.5 mg/kg per 12 hours of methylprednisolone (n = 61) or placebo (n = 59) for 5 days started within 36 hours of hospital admission.
